Name: Stone Bridge Over Lower Pond
Author: BayesianBandit
Description:
[size=4]Credit:[/size]
This mod is basically a recreation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/316]Stone Bridge Over Pond[/url], except for a few minor tweaks (bridge is a bit shorter) and the fact that it's built using PyTK/TMXL.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL[/url]
[*] Unzip [code][TMX] StoneBridgeOverLowerPond.zip[/code] into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility:[/size]
[list]
[*] Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.36 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*] Compatible with SMAPI 2.11.2 (untested on earlier versions, but it might still work).
[*] No known mod conflicts (let me know if you find one).
[*] Should be compatible with SMAPI 3.0.0 once it is released.
[/list]

[size=4]Source Code:[/size]
There is no source code except for what's in the download. This mod is under an MIT License (not that there's even enough of my own work here to realistically copyright, but whatever).

Manifest.Name: (TMX) StoneBridgeOverPond
Manifest.Description: Adds a stone bridge over the lower pond on the standard farm map.
Manifest.Author: BayesianBandit
